#  12441 - Introduction to eBusiness Technologies Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12441 - module is no longer offered from WS 2016/17**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Introduction to eBusiness Technologies**  |  
|  Einführung in eBusiness-Technologien   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. phil. habil. Wagner, Gerd 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | To get familiar with selected concepts, architectures and technologies of e-business systems.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Service-Oriented Architecure (SOA)
  * Basic Web service technologies: SOAP and WSDL
  * The Web service choreography language BPEL
  * The business process modeling language BPMN

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Participants must have good knowledge in Java-programming and web-technologies, equivalent to modules 
  * 12316: Specification Languages and Processing Techniques for Web Documents and
  * 12431: Designing and Implementing Web Applications.

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Research paper/essay / 60 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Will be distributed during the course.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Project assignments (graded, 40% of marks) 
  * Multiple choice tests (graded, 20% of marks) 
  * Final exam (graded, 40% of marks)

50% of the marks must be achieved altogether. Final grade is determined according to the specified mark proportions.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  |  **No courses in winter term 2015/16**
  * Study programme Computer Science M. Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex "Practical Computer Science" (level 400).
  * Study programme Information and Media Technology M. Sc.: Compulsory elective module in "Information Systems and Content Management".
  * Study programme eBusiness M. Sc.: Compulsory elective module main focus "Application and Operation of eBusiness Systems".
  * Study programme Industrial Engineering M. Sc. (field of study: Computer Science): Compulsory elective module in "Technical Subject II".

Old module title: „E-Business Technologies (ebTech)“  |  
| Module Components:  | Lecture: Web Services and E-Business TechnologiesAccompanying exercises  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment
